body:
Temple of Green

Gamemode: Nebula DTM
Creator: Pavlo
Teams: Green vs. Lime

Loadout:
-Leather helmet
-Iron Chestplate
-Chain leggins
-Leather boots

- Iron sword
- Infinity bow
- Efficiency 1 Diamond pick
- Efficiency 1 Iron axe
- 3 gapples
- 64 oak log
- 64 glass
- 64 cyan stained clay
- one water bucket (there's lots of jumps and falls)

Some Features:
- 2 Iron mines
- 4 monuments per team
- beacons mark monuments
- Spawn is up very high
- and more
